data.body: Fix landed on main under this ticket's own trailer: commit 7501cc1d602d ('Pin uv once so CI stops resolving it remotely', rebar-ticket: 56b7-b21a-c8ab-4afc). All acceptance criteria verified on origin/main: pyproject.toml pins required-version = "==0.12.7" (line 354); scripts/check_uv_pin.py + tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py exist; Makefile wires the guard into `make lint`; no workflow files modified; and the CI-log anchor AC was confirmed in the commit body (run 33230196661: five jobs log 'Found version for uv in .../pyproject.toml: 0.12.7', the 'Could not determine uv version' fallback gone). Attribution: PREEXISTING omission — `astral-sh/setup-uv` was SHA-pinned at all 25 call sites but uv itself was never pinned (no version input / [tool.uv] required-version / uv.toml), so the version-resolution manifest fetch was present since setup-uv was adopted. No single introducing commit broke a working behavior; unattributable to one ticket without a deeper bisect of the CI-setup history, hence --class=preexisting with no --caused-by. The RESIDUAL artifact-URL manifest fetch (a separate, narrower network call) is tracked by follow-on bug 5caa-4b63, not this ticket. Closing: this ticket's scope (pin uv → kill the version-resolution fetch) is complete and CI-verified.
